title: Context-Fractured Decomposition Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents: Exploiting Artifact Provenance Gaps
reasoning: The paper focuses on adversarial security attacks (jailbreaking) and artifact provenance in tool-using LLM agent pipelines.
